claims: The API exposes more than 100 planning and housing datasets for England through one interface.
A coordinate query returns entities whose geometry intersects the point and accepts multiple dataset parameters.
A UPRN passed through q is described as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties.
Entity responses may include dataset, reference, start-date, WKT geometry and WKT point.
Raw WKT geometry queries use WGS84 EPSG:4326 and explicit geometry_relation predicates.
Large result sets use limit and offset and responses provide next, previous, first and last links.
The API has no batch endpoint; bulk CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet downloads are recommended for large portfolios.
Bulk downloads provide a stable snapshot while API coverage and currentness must still be recorded.
Absence of API results is not evidence that no constraint exists because coverage varies by area.
The API is beta, so production use requires schema, temporal and fail-closed guards.

quality_guards: Do not bind references 52040420, 52213916 or 52213412 without exact candidate response bytes.
Do not replace an HMLR title-plan or determined-boundary record with a Planning Data entity.
Preserve dataset, reference, start-date, geometry CRS and snapshot lineage during reconciliation.
Treat endpoint, bulk-snapshot and candidate-specific evidence as separate provenance layers.
